# Link

Link is a component of `@kozmos-ds/react` whose docs do not describe it yet.

- **Import:** `import { Link } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Navigation
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/navigation-link--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Link, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function LinkExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Link href="#" variant="default">
        Default Link
      </Link>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Link

It forwards its ref to `HTMLAnchorElement`. Its props are `LinkProps`, which extends `React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>`.

- `variant`: `"default" | "subtle"`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
